reviewer: independent development subagent industrial_sources; not external institution or human attestation

math_checks.dot_product: Each explicit FMA update uses exact stored operands and introduces at most one full upward ulp of its saved finite result; nonnegative local errors outward-summed. No product rounding is omitted because multiplication is fused.
math_checks.complex: Reviewed all four real/complex A/X combinations. Real/imaginary products and final theta subtraction are separately bounded; real X with complex A correctly has no imaginary theta update.
math_checks.residual_components: Saved rr/ri absolute magnitude plus accumulated error, outward-added, bounds the true exact original-coordinate residual component. Nonfinite intermediate results propagate to rejection.
math_checks.norm_upper: Scale by largest nonnegative component bound, round division/square/sum/sqrt/product upward; componentwise dominance gives a strict residual 2-norm upper bound without unscaled-square overflow.
math_checks.norm_lower: Scale exact stored vector real/imag components by their exact largest magnitude; round each operation toward zero for nonnegative operands. Maximum of this lower result and exact max component remains a valid positive lower norm, including subnormal underflow.
math_checks.spectral_existence: For separately verified exact Hermitian A and nonzero x, radius=R2upper/X2lower bounds distance from theta to some eigenvalue. It does not establish nearest-k, absence of missing roots, multiplicity or target completeness.
math_checks.theta: Wrapper accepts only finite exactly representable binary64 theta; nonrepresentable Fraction values refuse rather than silently changing equation. Full experiment values are frozen float64.
math_checks.index_abi: 32-bit and 64-bit entrypoints share identical numerical implementation and differ only in CSR integer reads; bounds/shape/indices are validated separately.
math_checks.symmetry_check: Full real input checker validates all CSR structure/sorted unique entries/finiteness before reverse binary searches; upper-only/lower-only nonzero entries reject, exact signed zeros are harmless.
math_checks.platform: Current macOS arm64 binary64 FE_TONEAREST/gradual-underflow checks and compiler flags reviewed; correctly rounded FMA/sqrt/nextafter required. No cross-platform or formal machine-proof claim.
